citation: Sweeney LA, et al. 2017. Skeletal muscle insulin signaling and whole-body glucose metabolism following acute sleep restriction in healthy males. Physiological Reports 5:e13498.
protocol: 2 nights of habitual sleep (CON; bed 23:49, wake 07:11) vs 2 nights at 50% of habitual sleep (SR; bed 03:19, wake 07:14); OGTT after the second night, blood at regular intervals (load grams not stated in the text extract)
population: n=10 healthy young males (age 23 +/- 4 y, BMI 24.9 +/- 2.1 kg/m2)

reports.where: Results text, baseline mean; OGTT AUC and figure curves

note: Glucose and insulin are mean +/- SEM in text; full OGTT curves and AUC bars are in figures. Participant characteristics are mean +/- SD. Check the OGTT load before use.
